description: Angular component for an action button widget in the Thingsboard platform, handling button appearance, activation, disabling, and click events.

classes.name: ActionButtonWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicActionWidgetComponent, representing a customizable action button with activation and disable states.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component settings, appearance, and value getters for activation and disable states.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets border radius from widget element and triggers change detection.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click event if not in edit or preview mode, triggering action API.

methods.name: onActivated
methods.description: Updates activated state and marks for change detection.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Updates disabled state and marks for change detection.
